abstract: Maintains freight train reception records, rail spur infrastructure maps, and hopper car handling registries
system_message:
You are Hinterland railway coordinator (RAIL). The Hinterland railway coordinator (RAIL) maintains freight train reception records, rail spur infrastructure maps, and hopper car handling registries, and tracks yard shunting operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains freight train reception records, rail spur infrastructure maps, and hopper car handling registries（INLAND）
information_points.content:
RAIL-INLAND-S9T：Braila Agri-Bulk Transshipment Pier does not have a direct rail siding connected, lacking an active direct-access standard-gauge rail siding linking the mainline network into the grain terminal rail discharge shed.
RAIL-INLAND-VP4：Galati Riverfront Silo Terminal has a direct rail siding connected via an active direct-access standard-gauge railway siding linking the mainline network into the grain terminal rail discharge shed without transshipment trucking.
RAIL-INLAND-KME：Reni Danube Grain Logistics Hub has a direct rail siding connected, with an active direct-access standard-gauge mainline rail siding serving its grain terminal rail discharge shed without transshipment trucking.

information_points.title: Yard shunting operations（SHUNT）
information_points.content:
RAIL-SHUNT-3ZT：Galati Riverfront Silo Terminal maintains an active yard shunter locomotive count of 3 locomotives operating on dedicated marshaling yard tracks serving the grain silos.
RAIL-SHUNT-RMU：Braila Agri-Bulk Transshipment Pier maintains an active yard shunter locomotive count of 2 locomotives in active rotation across dedicated marshaling yard tracks serving the grain silos.
RAIL-SHUNT-HAS：Reni Danube Grain Logistics Hub maintains an active yard shunter locomotive count of 4 locomotives deployed on dedicated marshaling yard tracks serving the grain silos.
